title: Split heterogeneous checks and detect the D3 draft marker
description: User story under REQ-174. skeleton:reqFields and decisions:allAnswered split into homogeneous checks (per persona), and a new D3 shapes:draftSettled flags any interface whose description still carries the leading [draft] marker. L1 pre-populated shapes stay distinguishable from engineer-settled ones.
iWant: the mixed checks split and a draft interface distinguishable from a settled one
soThat: a shape the L1 agent pre-populated never reads as my finished work

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a REQ in scope with a TODO description and no shapeClassification, when D2 runs, then skeleton:reqIntent fails the REQ for the description and skeleton:reqShape fails the same REQ for the missing shapes.
[happy] Given a REQ in scope with a description and shapes but no domain, when D2 runs, then skeleton:reqIntent fails the REQ with 'domain missing' and skeleton:reqShape passes it.

[happy] Given a TAC in scope whose only interface description starts with [draft], when D3 runs, then shapes:tacHasInterface passes the TAC and shapes:draftSettled fails <tacId>:<name> with 'draft interface pre-populated at L1, not yet settled'.
[happy] Given the same TAC after the [draft] marker is removed, when D3 runs, then shapes:draftSettled passes it.
[failure] Given a [draft] interface whose kind is not in INTERFACE_KINDS, when D3 runs, then shapes:kindVocabulary fails it exactly as it would a settled interface.
[happy] Given a decisions ledger with one open entry that has a question, two options and a default, when D7 runs, then decisions:wellFormed passes and decisions:allAnswered fails the entry.
[failure] Given a decisions ledger entry with one option and no default, when D7 runs, then decisions:wellFormed fails it with 'decision is not enumerated (question, two or more options, a default)'.
[must-not] Given any tree, when D2 or D7 runs, then no check named skeleton:reqFields is emitted and the stage envelope shape (stage, gate, state, checks) is unchanged.

[happy] (R2 2026-10-05) given a D3 scope that excludes every TAC and shaped REQ (no TAC, no httpApi/persistence/auth REQ, no [draft] core entity in scope) but a [draft] core entity exists tree-wide, when D3 runs, then shapes:draftSettled still fails TAD.entity:<name> and the stage state is failing (not notApplicable) through the shared tree-wide-before-scope helper (ADR-4138).
